text:
alex: Heads-up — after the kernel-selector change landed in staging, end-to-end throughput on the 8xA100 PP run dropped ~12% and p99 latency jumped ~30ms. nvprof/NVTX shows big gaps around the all-reduces.

maria: Got a quick flamegraph or nvtx dump? can you paste the hot ranges?

alex: Quick NVTX snippet from the trace:
```text
NVTX: [FW] 0.48ms -> [AR] 8.2ms -> [BW] 0.62ms -> [AR] 8.1ms
NVTX: repeated per microbatch, AR dominates
```

jon: That looks like all-reduce latency dominating the PP bubble. Did the kernel change result in smaller / more frequent collectives?

tanya: Are we still on 1F1B schedule? microbatch size?

alex: Yes 1F1B. microbatch=4, per-device global batch 16. The adaptive batching heuristic (new kernel selector) picked a fused int8 attention kernel for some layers; microbenchmarks looked fine but in PP it seems to change message sizes.

luis: Two quick hypotheses: 1) kernel fusion changed activation shapes causing NCCL to do more small all-reduces; 2) KV-cache warming/evictions causing serialized stalls between stages. Both increase wall-clock AR cost.

maria: If ARs are smaller and more numerous, comm/compute overlap matters a lot. Do we start the all-reduce early enough? NVTX should show whether overlap exists.

alex: Profiling command I used (for reproducibility):
```bash
python -m perf.trace --nvtx --profile --model llama-7b --pp 4 --microbatch 4 --kernelselector new --tag 1769901123
```
Profile uploaded: https://perf.redwood/sessions/1769901123

perf-bot: Profile processed, summary: 12% throughput regression vs baseline, AR mean latency +6.7ms, bufferization changed in 3 layers.

jon: Seen this before — fused kernels sometimes reduce compute slightly but increase memory fragmentation, leading to more cache flushes and smaller NCCL payloads. All-reduce overhead then becomes the bottleneck in multi-GPU PP.

tanya: Proposed action items:
- sweep microbatch in [2,4,8] to see bubble length vs AR cost
- toggle kernel selector back to old heuristic for comparison
- run NCCL configs (ring vs tree, change NCCL_NTHREADS/NCCL_ALGO)
- add NVTX markers to force earlier AR kickoff to increase overlap

luis: Also add KV-cache occupancy checks. If kv cache is cold the 1F1B pipeline can stall waiting on cache loads. Prefetch/warm-first-token might help.

maria: Can someone queue a batch of runs? I can help collect ggmetrics and generate a per-layer AR size distribution.

alex: I'll queue the sweep tonight: microbatch=2,4,8 x kernel-selector {new,old} x NCCL_ALGO {ring,tree}. Will attach NVTX frames and nccl-tests outputs.

jon: Also capture host CPU/NIC stats — sometimes small messages trigger host aggregation that becomes the hidden hotspot.

tanya: I'll draft a short runbook for 1F1B tuning: microbatch sizing, kernel-selector flags, nvtx instrumentation, kv-warmup step, and recommended NCCL env vars. Will PR once we have numbers.

alex: Thanks. I'll post run summaries and links to the perf sessions here once done. :pray:
